modules.title: 按钮文件没有问题时，为什么下一步要改查网络请求
真实结果怎样改变下一步

items.title: 先确认一个具体判断
items.text: 登录按钮没有反应时，先检查按钮是否绑定点击事件，而不是同时修改多个位置。

items.title: 读取操作产生的真实结果
items.text: 文件显示点击事件已经存在，这条证据直接否定了最初判断。

items.title: 根据结果更换检查方向
items.text: 按钮点击后出现 401，下一步改查认证信息；这里展示的是任务状态，不是模型的完整内部推理。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: ReAct 描述的是“任务级判断 → 行动 → 观察”的交替模式；工具调用只是其中一次行动的表达，Agent 循环则是运行时负责权限、重试、记录和停止条件的控制机制。界面不应声称展示完整内部推理。

lessonPractice.title: Agent 认为登录按钮缺少点击事件，但读取文件后发现点击事件已经存在。下一步怎样处理更符合 ReAct？

options.label: 根据文件结果放弃原判断，改查点击后发出的网络请求
options.feedback: 对。真实观察否定了原判断，下一步应该改查仍未解释的网络请求。

options.label: 继续重写按钮点击代码，因为最初已经认定问题在按钮
options.feedback: 文件已经证明点击事件存在，继续按原判断修改会忽略刚得到的证据。

options.label: 直接宣布按钮代码没有问题，不再检查点击后的真实结果
options.feedback: 确认一个位置没有问题，不代表故障已经解释；还要根据现有证据选择下一处检查。

en.title: An agent assumes a login button has no click handler, but the file shows that the handler already exists. What should happen next in a ReAct pattern?

options.label: Drop the original assumption and inspect the network request triggered by the click
options.feedback: Correct. The file result disproves the original assumption, so the next action investigates the unexplained network behavior.

options.label: Rewrite the click handler anyway because the original plan blamed the button
options.feedback: The file already shows a handler, so continuing the original edit ignores the latest evidence.

options.label: Declare the button correct and stop without checking what happens after the click
options.feedback: Clearing one location does not explain the failure; the observation should direct the next check.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请按 ReAct 方式排查这个问题：先说明当前要确认什么，再执行一次读取或检查；看到结果后更新判断，再决定下一步。新证据否定原判断时要更换检查方向，不要继续按原猜测修改。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Use a ReAct pattern to diagnose this issue. State one thing to verify, perform one read or check, update the task-level conclusion from the result, and then choose the next action. If evidence disproves the original assumption, change direction instead of continuing the same edit.

references.title: ReAct：让语言模型交替进行推理与行动

learning.assumes: You have seen an assistant read files, change content, and report checks.
learning.outcome: You can explain why real observations change the next action and distinguish ReAct from an agent loop.

modules.title: Why inspect the network request when the button file is correct?
How a real result changes the next action

items.title: Verify one concrete assumption
items.text: For a button that does nothing, first check whether it has a click handler.

items.title: Read the actual result
items.text: The file shows that the click handler already exists, disproving the first assumption.

items.title: Change the investigation
items.text: A 401 after the click moves the next check to authentication. This is task state, not private chain of thought.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: ReAct is the alternation of task-level judgment, action, and observation. A tool call is one action; an agent loop controls permissions, retries, records, and stopping.
